declaration.theory: strict linearized four-dimensional pure Weyl C^2 gravity
declaration.boundary_class: future-horizon regular and zero-incoming/pure-outgoing at infinity

scalar_boundary_problem.future_horizon_regular: u tends to a finite nonzero constant, hence psi is proportional to exp(+I*omega*rstar)
scalar_boundary_problem.pure_outgoing_infinity: u is proportional to exp(-2*I*omega*rstar), hence psi is proportional to exp(-I*omega*rstar)
scalar_boundary_problem.L2_reading: Both factors decay at their respective ends when Im(omega)<0.
scalar_boundary_problem.no_mode_argument: The left side and L2 norm are real nonnegative. If Re(omega)!=0 and Im(omega)<0, omega**2 is nonreal; if Re(omega)=0, omega**2<0. Both contradict the identity for a nonzero mode.

future_horizon.germ_sequence: 0 -> H_RW_metric -> H_full -> H_RW_carrier -> H_x -> 0 as a three-step exact filtration on future-horizon-regular germs

pure_outgoing_infinity.germ_sequence: 0 -> O_RW_metric -> O_full -> O_RW_carrier -> O_x -> 0 as a three-step exact filtration on pure-outgoing infinity germs

complex_frequency_regularities.horizon_recurrence_reading: For Im(omega)<0 and positive integer n, both factors have positive real part and cannot vanish.
complex_frequency_regularities.endpoint_rate_reading: The ingoing and outgoing rates are distinct because omega!=0.

intrinsic_boundary_map_audit.carrier_quotient: K: M_A4 -> M_x with K_prime+K*A4=A_x*K and K*J=0
intrinsic_boundary_map_audit.reading: Boundary preservation is a property of the chain maps on the weighted ingoing/outgoing germ modules. The displayed endpoint frames only witness ranks; their normalization denominators do not define the boundary theorem.

boundary_devissage.boundary_preservation: Every filtration projection/inclusion is a local rational differential map regular in the LHP and maps the declared horizon and infinity germ classes to the corresponding scalar germ class.
boundary_devissage.boundary_exactness: The exact local factor frames prove exactness on each endpoint germ space. On the simultaneous two-ended boundary kernel, left exactness and exact kernel identification suffice for successive elimination; surjectivity is not assumed.
successive_elimination: Project a full boundary mode to the spin-one L_x quotient. The projected mode has both boundary conditions and is zero by the spin-one energy theorem.
Exactness puts the carrier in the spin-two RW submodule. Its scalar master has both boundary conditions and is zero by the spin-two energy theorem.
The remaining full mode lies in the metric spin-two RW kernel. Its scalar master has both boundary conditions and is zero by the spin-two energy theorem.
boundary_devissage.conclusion: The complete six-state axial ell=2 Bach system has no nonzero future-horizon-regular, pure-outgoing separated mode with Im(omega)<0.
boundary_devissage.scope: Separated-mode spectral no-growth theorem; not a time-domain boundedness or full PDE stability theorem.

regularized_Evans.normalization: Each A_in_s is the incoming coefficient at infinity of the scalar spin-s Jost solution normalized to unit future-horizon-regular amplitude.
regularized_Evans.intrinsic_reading: E_reg omits all rational endpoint-frame prefactors from det(Tminus) and depends only on the two scalar factor boundary problems.
regularized_Evans.analytic_domain: Im(omega)<0, omega!=0, with standard short-range Jost normalization

simple_spin_two_QNM_extension_gate.local_ring: O is the discrete valuation ring of analytic germs at omega_star.
simple_spin_two_QNM_extension_gate.general_local_model: After filtration-preserving analytic left/right equivalences, the two-copy extension has matrix [[a,c],[0,a]] over O.
simple_spin_two_QNM_extension_gate.frame_law: c -> u*c+a*d where u is a unit and d is in O.
simple_spin_two_QNM_extension_gate.invariant_extension_class: [c] in O/(a), defined up to multiplication by a unit.
simple_spin_two_QNM_extension_gate.simple_zero_specialization: For m=1: n=0 gives diag(1,delta**2), while n>=1 gives diag(delta,delta), with delta=omega-omega_star.
simple_spin_two_QNM_extension_gate.identification: At a simple zero, c(omega_star) is a normalization multiple of Gamma_star; neither factor is certified nonzero here.
simple_spin_two_QNM_extension_gate.spectral_derivative_next_test: Test whether c == q*A_in_2_prime modulo A_in_2 in O/(A_in_2).
simple_spin_two_QNM_extension_gate.spectral_derivative_status: OPEN: neither the congruence nor nonvanishing of q modulo A_in_2 is claimed.
simple_spin_two_QNM_extension_gate.required_computation: Construct normalized spin-two QNM and adjoint QNM germs in a regular analytic patch, pull back the exact full-system extension, and evaluate Gamma_star with a boundary-convergent Fredholm pairing.
simple_spin_two_QNM_extension_gate.claim: No Smith case is selected by the present certificate.

positive_real_direct_integral_context.reading: An all-positive-frequency direct integral requires this weighted majorant rather than an unweighted coordinate norm.

upper_half_plane_frame_events.phase_reading: Im(omega)>0 is damped, not growing, for exp(+I*omega*t).
